description: This file defines the DocModel class in the Aws\Api namespace, responsible for encapsulating and retrieving documentation strings related to AWS service versions, operations, errors, and shapes. It provides methods to access specific documentation segments and processes them (e.g., cleaning with the tidy extension).

classes.name: Aws\Api\DocModel
classes.description: Class that manages documentation strings for AWS service models, allowing retrieval of service, operation, error, and shape documentation with content cleaning capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DocModel with documentation data, requiring the 'tidy' PHP extension.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the entire documentation data as an array.

methods.name: getServiceDocs
methods.description: Retrieves documentation related to the overall service.

methods.name: getOperationDocs
methods.description: Retrieves documentation for a specific operation.

methods.name: getErrorDocs
methods.description: Retrieves documentation for a specific error shape.

methods.name: getShapeDocs
methods.description: Retrieves documentation for a specific shape and context, with logic to include references and append additional messages.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Uses the 'tidy' extension to sanitize and format HTML content within documentation.
